en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large military parade passing in front of an ornate neo‑Renaissance stone building. Infantry soldiers wearing early 20th‑century uniforms and helmets march with rifles, while a mounted officer on horseback rides at the front. A dense crowd of civilians watches from the street and from balconies and windows of the grand façade behind them, which features arched windows, heavy rustication, sculpted figures and balustraded balconies. The overall impression is of a ceremonial review or victory parade in a European city.
